nodes.name: footer.ts
nodes.summary: RunFooter — the mutable control surface of direct interactive mode, owning the boundary between append-only scrollback (queued StreamCommit flushes) and the repaintable SolidJS footer region, plus lifecycle (close/destroy), view routing, and interrupt/exit double-press timers.
nodes.languageNotes: Scrollback commits coalesce in a microtask queue; footer state lives in a SolidJS store reconciled via minimal FooterPatch objects.

nodes.name: eventPatch
nodes.summary: Computes the minimal FooterPatch from a footer event for store reconciliation.

nodes.name: RunFooter
nodes.summary: Mutable footer controller owning scrollback commit queues, SolidJS footer state, view presentation and height management, prompt/close listeners, and interrupt/exit double-press timers wired to the renderer lifecycle.

nodes.name: footer.view.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level footer layout for direct interactive mode, stacking the composer frame (prompt/permission/question bodies via Switch/Match), meta row with agent and model labels, and a status row with spinner, interrupt hint, duration, and usage.

nodes.name: RunFooterView
nodes.summary: Stateless top-level footer layout switching between prompt, permission, and question composer bodies with meta and status rows; all state arrives from the parent RunFooter via SolidJS signals.

nodes.name: keymap.shared.ts
nodes.summary: Pure keymap helpers that parse configured key bindings into OpenTUI key sequences with alias normalization (delete to del, meta to alt) and format them back into printable binding strings.

nodes.name: createParser
nodes.summary: Builds an OpenTUI keymap parser with alias normalization and leader-key registration for binding parsing.

nodes.name: parseBindings
nodes.summary: Parses configured key binding strings into normalized key sequence parts.

nodes.name: otel.ts
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry span helpers for the run command, wrapping footer and loop operations in traced spans with attribute and error recording over a lazily initialized observability runtime.

nodes.name: withRunSpan
nodes.summary: Wraps an Effect operation in an OpenTelemetry span with run attributes and automatic error recording, falling back to a no-op span when tracing is unavailable.

nodes.name: permission.shared.ts
nodes.summary: Pure three-stage state machine for the permission UI (permission, always-confirmation, reject text) that returns new state plus optional PermissionReply payloads; kept side-effect free for independent testing.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the .shared.ts convention: pure functions take state in and return new state out, with no IO or TUI dependencies.

nodes.name: createPermissionBodyState
nodes.summary: Creates the initial permission body state for a request ID with the permission stage selected.

nodes.name: permissionOptions
nodes.summary: Returns the selectable options (allow once, always, reject) for the current permission stage.

nodes.name: permissionInfo
nodes.summary: Extracts display info — icon, title, detail lines, and diff — from a permission request.

nodes.name: permissionAlwaysLines
nodes.summary: Builds the confirmation lines shown in the always-grant stage.

nodes.name: permissionShift
nodes.summary: Moves the selected option horizontally with clamping at both ends.

nodes.name: permissionRun
nodes.summary: Main state transition: applies the selected option, advancing stages or emitting a PermissionReply to send to the SDK.

nodes.name: permissionEscape
nodes.summary: Handles escape per stage — cancels confirmation, clears reject text, or rejects the request outright.

nodes.name: prompt.shared.ts
nodes.summary: Pure state machine for the prompt input: keybind parsing, leader-key variant cycling with two-step arming, and a bounded 200-entry history ring that saves the draft when browsing and restores it past the newest entry.
nodes.languageNotes: Exemplar of the .shared.ts pattern: pure computation extracted from the reactive UI component and pinned by characterization tests.

nodes.name: promptInfo
nodes.summary: Extracts the prompt display info (mode icon, agent label) for the footer meta row.

nodes.name: promptKey
nodes.summary: Normalizes a key event into a canonical binding key string with alias mapping.

nodes.name: mapInputBindings
nodes.summary: Maps configured bindings through an action transform for textarea input handling.

nodes.name: promptKeys
nodes.summary: Derives the printable hint keys for the prompt footer from the configured keybinds.

nodes.name: promptHit
nodes.summary: Tests whether a key event matches any of the given parsed bindings.

nodes.name: promptCycle
nodes.summary: Two-step leader-key cycle: the first press arms the leader and the second press within the timeout fires variant or command actions.

nodes.name: createPromptHistory
nodes.summary: Creates the bounded prompt history ring with a draft slot and browse position.

nodes.name: pushPromptHistory
nodes.summary: Commits a submitted prompt into the history ring, evicting entries past the 200-item limit.

nodes.name: movePromptHistory
nodes.summary: Navigates history up and down — saving the draft on first entry and restoring it when moving past the newest entry — returning text and cursor adjustments for the caller to apply.

nodes.name: autocomplete.ts
nodes.summary: Pure autocomplete logic for the prompt textarea — mention (@) and slash (/) head detection, line-range extraction for file mentions, and cursor-aware query parsing with no TUI or SolidJS dependencies.

nodes.name: extractLineRange
nodes.summary: Parses a mention token into its base path plus an optional line range suffix (:10 or :10-20).

nodes.name: slashHead
nodes.summary: Extracts the slash command head (name and argument offset) from a text line.

nodes.name: slashQuery
nodes.summary: Computes the active slash-command query from the current text and cursor position.

nodes.name: parts.ts
nodes.summary: Mention part manager for the prompt textarea, tracking @mention parts (files and agents) and syncing extmarks against textarea edits so highlights survive restores and insertions.

nodes.name: syncParts
nodes.summary: Recomputes mention extmark ranges after textarea edits using tracked line and column deltas.

nodes.name: restoreParts
nodes.summary: Reapplies saved mention marks to a freshly restored textarea value.

nodes.name: insertMention
nodes.summary: Inserts an @mention at the cursor, replacing the query text and registering its extmark.

nodes.name: prompt-state.tsx
nodes.summary: The prompt textarea state machine and component: wires keybinds, history navigation, leader-key sequences, @-mention autocomplete over files/subagents/MCP resources, and slash command handling into the PromptState consumed by RunPromptBody.

nodes.name: RunPromptBody
nodes.summary: Renders the prompt textarea with hint rows and the autocomplete menu below it.

nodes.name: createPromptState
nodes.summary: Builds the full prompt state machine — keybind wiring, history navigation, leader sequences, @-mention autocomplete over files/subagents/resources, mention part management, and slash command validation.

nodes.name: submit.ts
nodes.summary: Pure submit validation for the prompt textarea: parses slash commands, detects exit commands, and validates prompts before dispatch.

nodes.name: parseSlashCommand
nodes.summary: Parses prompt text into a slash command name plus arguments when the input is a command.

nodes.name: validateSubmit
nodes.summary: Validates a prompt before dispatch, rejecting empty input and unknown slash commands.

nodes.name: question.shared.ts
nodes.summary: Pure state machine for the question UI covering single- and multi-question flows — option picking, tab navigation, custom text answers, and final QuestionReply assembly — with no TUI dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Single questions submit immediately on selection; multi-question flows use tabs plus a final confirmation step.

nodes.name: createQuestionBodyState
nodes.summary: Creates the initial question body state for a request with tab and selection defaults.

nodes.name: questionPick
nodes.summary: Picks an answer — submitting immediately for single questions or toggling and advancing for multi-question flows.

nodes.name: questionToggle
nodes.summary: Toggles a multi-select answer in a question's picked set.

nodes.name: questionMove
nodes.summary: Moves the selected option up and down with clamping and custom-input handling.

nodes.name: questionSelect
nodes.summary: Digit-shortcut selection handler that picks an option by index.

nodes.name: questionSave
nodes.summary: Saves custom text input for the active question tab, validating and storing the answer.

nodes.name: questionHint
nodes.summary: Builds the footer hint line describing the available keys for the current question state.

nodes.name: runtime.boot.ts
nodes.summary: Boot-time resolution for direct interactive mode, concurrently fetching footer keybinds from TUI config, diff display style, model variant lists with context limits, and session history before the first frame renders.

nodes.name: footerKeybinds
nodes.summary: Maps TUI keybind configuration into the footer's keybinding structure with leader defaults.
